law_name: Law of 18 April 2001 on Copyright, Neighbouring Rights and Databases
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (anonymous and collective works: 70 years from publication)
moral_rights: Paternity & integrity (survive transfer of economic rights; author decides on disclosure)
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list of exceptions (InfoSoc Directive art. 5; DSM Directive 2019/790: text and data mining, teaching, preservation)
enforcement_body: Intellectual Property Office, Ministry of the Economy
